layers.name: app
layers.purpose: Entry point (src/main.tsx) and page layout (src/App.tsx) that put the features together; may import every lower layer.

layers.name: features
layers.purpose: React UI, one folder per feature; may import shared/ui, utils, context, types but never another feature folder.

layers.name: shared/ui
layers.purpose: Presentational building blocks shared by features; may import only its own files and types.

layers.name: utils
layers.purpose: Helpers (URL state sharing, expand/collapse animation); may import context and types.

layers.name: context
layers.purpose: AppStateContext, the central app state; may import only types.

layers.name: types
layers.purpose: Shared domain types; imports nothing else from src.
